skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use listening and speaking skills in international business context fluently.
Develop vocabulary, terminology, and structures of specialized English in international business.
Understand functions, roles, theories of international trade and apply them to analyze multinational company activities.
Understand nature, classification, and impact of foreign direct investment and apply them to analyze multinational company activities.
Classify and understand various international business environments including cultural, economic, political, and legal environments.
Analyze the impact of international business environment.
Understand the nature and characteristics of organizational structures and management in international business.
Understand principles of strategic management in international business.
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work.
Demonstrate skills in gathering information and analyzing activities of a multinational company.
